title: Review: the 7 cases

video.title: सप्तविभक्तयः: विभक्तियों के अर्थ, उदाहरण
video.focus: For each case, note its job and one example sentence; pause and say the example aloud.

recap: Your Day 26 quiz answers didn't come in, so here's a warm-up first. W1: What is the 3rd case plural of राम? W2: रामाभ्याम् can be which three cases? W3: Say 'Rama's friends live in the village.'
idea: Today is a **review day**: no new grammar. A **case (विभक्ति, vibhakti)** is the ending that shows a noun's job in the sentence. Here are all of them on one screen, with the Hindi word that usually matches.
## The cases at a glance (singular of बालक)
- 1st प्रथमा, subject: **बालकः** पठति (बालक पढ़ता है)
- 2nd द्वितीया, object or 'to' a place: बालकः **पुस्तकम्** पठति; **ग्रामम्** गच्छति (को / -)
- 3rd तृतीया, 'with, by means of'; also with सह: **हस्तेन**, **मित्रेण** सह (से, के साथ)
- 4th चतुर्थी, 'to, for': **बालकाय** फलं ददाति; **देवाय** नमः (को, के लिए)
- 5th पञ्चमी, 'from' (moving away): **वृक्षात्** पत्रं पतति (से)
- 6th षष्ठी, 'of': **बालकस्य** पुस्तकम् (का, की, के)
- 7th सप्तमी, 'in, on, at': **ग्रामे**, **वृक्षे** (में, पर)
- Vocative सम्बोधन, calling: **हे बालक** (हे)
## Two Hindi traps
- Hindi **से** splits into two Sanskrit cases: 'with/by' = 3rd (हस्तेन), 'from' = 5th (वृक्षात्).
- Hindi **को** also splits: the object = 2nd (बालकं पश्यति), 'to/for' a person you give to = 4th (बालकाय ददाति).
**Video note:** if the video gives 'ने' for the 1st case, that's a Hindi habit; Sanskrit has no ने. The 1st case is simply the subject.
## Translation task: 5 sentences
Translate into Sanskrit and send them with your quiz answers as T1-T5:
- T1: The farmer goes to the field.
- T2: A flower falls from the tree.
- T3: The father gives fruit to the boy.
- T4: The boy eats fruit with a spoon.
- T5: O Rama, the people live in the village.

examples.meaning: A leaf falls from the tree. (5th)
The farmer's field is in the village. (6th, 7th)

examples.dev: हे मित्र, अद्य आकाशे सूर्यः नास्ति।
examples.iast: he mitra, adya ākāśe sūryaḥ nāsti.
examples.meaning: O friend, there is no sun in the sky today. (vocative, 7th)

quiz.q: Hindi से can match which two Sanskrit cases?
In रामाय नमः, which case is रामाय?
quiz.why: -आय is the 4th case singular ('to, for'); नमः takes the 4th case.

quiz.q: Choose the right word: बालकः ___ लिखति। (The boy writes with his hand.)
quiz.why: The tool you use takes the 3rd case: हस्तेन.

quiz.q: Which form means 'the boys' as the object (2nd case plural)?
quiz.why: 2nd plural ends in -आन्: बालकान्. बालकाः is 1st plural; बालकानाम् is 6th plural.

quiz.q: Fill in the 6th case of मित्र: ___ पुस्तकम् (the friend's book)
